notes: Status reports source metadata availability, not a cryptographic integrity audit.
Counts cover the authorized public corpus only; public collections also merge other site records.
Transcript availability does not measure transcript completeness or accuracy. Unknown values are null, not zero.
checkedAt is the status check time; metadata may be cached for five minutes. It is not a source update time.
authorizedAt is release authorization; publishedAt is recorded pointer promotion time, not source update time.
Conference dates come from the registry. Schedule availability is checked separately by get_schedule; this status does not probe schedules.
